title: Dholavira UNESCO World Heritage tag
subject: Geography
caption: Map of India highlighting Gujarat and marking Dholavira as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
altText: A textbook-quality map of India on a white background, with state borders clearly drawn. The state of Gujarat is shaded in a light pastel color. A small red dot with a thin black outline marks the location of Dholavira within Gujarat. Next to the dot, a bold black label reads "Dholavira – UNESCO World Heritage Site" and includes the UNESCO emblem. A legend in the lower right explains the shading and the UNESCO symbol. The illustration is high resolution, accurate, and all labels are clearly legible.
